text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, when I visited the Expedition Support Committee... someone was already there.
choice_data_list: Are you discussing the overseas trip?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It seems Curren-san
has an interest in Hokkaido during the summer.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "On top of planning the expedition, she's also looking up picturesque photo spots."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I wanted to share memories of our
trip on social media, too♪

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Keeping records is vital, after all. Well then,
without further ado... allow me to make a few suggestions.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
First, about the trip to Hakodate Racecourse.
If you have some free time in the morning,
I recommend the morning market in front of Hakodate Station.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
A morning market! That feels so Hokkaido!
Seafood bowls and stuff always go viral, right?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of seasonal summer ingredients, squid comes to mind.
At night, the lights from the squid fishing boats
are clearly visible from the port—it's truly quite beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I see!
So I need to check it both morning and night!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let us head to the racecourse.
Hakodate Racecourse has the longest history among all currently existing racecourses in Japan.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, it is the only racetrack owned by the URA
where you can view the ocean right from the stands.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! The sea, the racetrack, and Curren...
Yeah, sounds perfect♪

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure it'll make for a truly special photo.
Furthermore, there's also a hot spring here
available for participating Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
If you would like to use them too, Trainer,
there are hot spring inns nearby,
so it is possible to enjoy them together.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Hakodate Racecourse also has a woodchip track,
so it would be best to complete your tune-up here as well.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
For now...
how does something like this look?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That was way too much info for just a "first off"!
It's amazing how easily you reel all that out!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
No, not to that extent...
As part of the Expedition Support Committee, I just make sure
to have the minimum necessary knowledge, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's a wonderful committee, isn't it?
I think everyone really appreciates it♪

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Hearing you say so is an honor, but...
we don't have many users. It's a lack of PR, clearly.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Huh, if I remember correctly, the committee
has an Umastagram account, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Her posts are great too,
and she had quite a few followers, didn't she?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I am grateful for that. However...
It doesn't seem to go so far as having them visit the committee.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
If only I too... had a wealth of ideas
like Ms. Curren does.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...I see♪ In that case,
how about a collab stream with Curren?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Your posts are always
so polished and easy to understand,
Journey-san.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "Maybe that actually makes it feel just a tiiiiny bit more prestigious!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Still, if I show everyone on stream what the vibe is really like,
maybe more people will come!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: I see. As expected of you, Curren-san. I'd love to do a collab stream with you.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: I just hope I can be of help to as many people as possible.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: I just hope I can be of help to as many people as possible.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In Dream Journey's words, I sense a devotion
that extends unconditionally to anyone.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
What a curious thing to ask...
Why, you say?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "Expeditions are of utmost importance. A thoroughly prepared journey leads to flawless results."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
No matter who they are, I want them to have a pleasant journey...
It's only natural to want to lend a hand.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Wah, how lovely~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Once everyone learns about your noble goal, Journey-san,
I'm sure they'll all want to make use of it!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I hope so.
—Good luck with your stream.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, did you see Curren-chan's stream?
Journey-san is actually super sweet, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Huh, why was I avoiding this place until now...?
Maybe I'll check it out next time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the day after the stream,
the number of Umamusume visiting the Expedition Support Committee... seems to be steadily increasing.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
I'm counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
“—And so! Today we're coming to you live
from the Expedition Support Committee~!”

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh! "I've been curious about that committee!"
"Never got around to checking it out... thanks for the intro!"
The comments are pouring in!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for your interest.
I'm open to taking any questions you might have—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"The stream had a really great reception!
I'm sure lots of girls will come by♪"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you ever so much.
It's all thanks to your immense influence, Curren-san."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
For a long time, regarding social media management and interpersonal relations...
I've felt there is so much I can learn from you.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Please feel free to visit the committee anytime.
...I look forward to our continued good relationship.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"I'm happy.
Curren's the one who should be saying, 'let's do our best together'!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren really loves people like you too,
Journey-san...♪
